msg: Notice period of {found} to start switching. Chapter VI caps the notice period for initiating switching at two months (Art. 25(2)). Write: 'no more than two months'.

Transitional period of {found}. The mandatory maximum transitional period is 30 calendar days (Art. 25(2)); a longer one is only lawful as a notified extension when the switch is technically unfeasible.
Retrieval window of {found}. The customer must keep at least a 30-day minimum retrieval period after the contract ends (Art. 25(2)) before exportable data may be erased.
Egress charge named in an exit clause. Data-transfer-out charges for switching are being withdrawn under Art. 29 and are prohibited from 12 January 2027.
Switching charge with no 12 January 2027 sunset on the same line. Until then only reduced charges not exceeding the costs incurred are allowed (Art. 29); from 12 January 2027 the charge must be zero.
Per-gigabyte price attached to getting data out. A volume price is not a cost-based reduced switching charge and cannot survive 12 January 2027 (Art. 29).
Early-termination penalty in a switching clause is a contractual obstacle to switching (Art. 23). Price the remaining term, not the act of leaving.
Clause disclaims any duty to help the customer leave. Art. 25(2) requires the provider to give reasonable assistance with the switching process.
Auto-renewal that removes the right to terminate blocks the two-month switching notice (Art. 23, Art. 25(2)).
Data erased at termination. Erasure may only follow the retrieval period of at least 30 days (Art. 25(2)).
Export offered only in a proprietary format. Exportable data must be provided in a structured, commonly used and machine-readable format (Art. 30).
Wrong applicability date for the Data Act. Regulation (EU) 2023/2854 entered into force in January 2024 but applies from 12 September 2025.
No clause granting the right to switch to another provider or to on-premises ICT infrastructure (Art. 25(2)).
No promise of a structured, commonly used, machine-readable export format for exportable data and digital assets (Art. 30).
No assistance clause. The contract must state the reasonable assistance given during the switching process (Art. 25(2)).
The jurisdictions where the ICT infrastructure for processing and storage is located are not disclosed (Art. 26).
No reference to an up-to-date register of the data structures and data formats the customer can export (Art. 26).
Infrastructure-service contracts must address functional equivalence in the destination environment (Art. 30).
No named point of contact for switching requests, so a switching request has no address to arrive at (Art. 26).

msg_before: This contract still prices leaving. Switching charges must be zero from 12 January 2027 - {days} days from {today}.
msg_after: Switching charges have been prohibited since 12 January 2027 (Art. 29) and this contract still prices leaving.
